0022600130.text: The Spurs (1-2) host the Sacramento Kings (0-3) in San Antonio's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Spurs 3rd in the Southwest and 2 games back and 9th in the West, after a 1-0 road start and an 0-2 home record. Sacramento, 15th in the West and 3 games back in the Pacific, enters on a three-game losing streak after losing both of its home games. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17.
